philosophy: winner DNA: what was visible before big winners moved, versus matched look-alikes (stage 1 on the older half only: data/squad7-dna.json), turned into rules registered before the newer half was looked at
preRegistered: squad7-core.mjs RULES (24 Oct 2026, after stage 1, before any newer-half number) + data/strategy-library.json SQ7-*
standard: both halves (signal before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2% cost, better than the average liquid stock over the same entry-to-exit sessions, better than the same stock on its other days, > 0 without the 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks, block t >= 2.5 -> TRADABLE SMALL; block t >= 4.02 -> PROVEN. Gross returns capped at +300% for trades and yardsticks alike (AUD-1).

SQ7-DEEPGAP.why: block t 1.04 under 2.5 in the older half; lost money after 0.8% costs in the newer half; lost money after 1.2% costs in the newer half; not better than the average stock in the newer half; loses without its 2 best in the newer half; block t -1.42 under 2.5 in the newer half
SQ7-DEEPGAP.name: Beaten-down stock (33%+ under its 200-day) that gapped up 3%+ in the last month and is not diluting (hold 20)
SQ7-DEEPGAP.rule: Close >= 33% under its 200-day average (d200 <= -0.33); at least one opening gap of +3% or more in the last 20 sessions (gapUp20 >= 1); share count up no more than 0.8% in a year (dShares <= 0.008, both counts known 30 days late). Rank: deepest under the 200-day first; max 10 a day. Hold 20 sessions.
SQ7-DEEPGAP.yardstick: capBoth (AUD-1 corrected: trades and yardstick capped at +300% alike)

SQ7-DEEPEARN.why: block t 1.07 under 2.5 in the older half; lost money after 1.2% costs in the newer half; not better than the average stock in the newer half; loses without its 2 best in the newer half; block t -1.8 under 2.5 in the newer half
SQ7-DEEPEARN.name: Beaten-down stock (33%+ under its 200-day) with its next report near (59-85 days since the last) (hold 20)
SQ7-DEEPEARN.rule: Close >= 33% under its 200-day average; the last earnings report on the Nasdaq calendar was 59 to 85 calendar days before the signal close (the next report usually falls inside the 20-session hold). Rank: deepest under the 200-day first; max 10 a day. Hold 20 sessions.
SQ7-DEEPEARN.yardstick: capBoth (AUD-1 corrected: trades and yardstick capped at +300% alike)

SQ7-BUYBACKVOL.why: not better than the same stocks on their other days in the older half; block t 0.93 under 2.5 in the older half; not better than the average stock in the newer half; block t -1.42 under 2.5 in the newer half
SQ7-BUYBACKVOL.name: Buyback company (share count down 3%+ in a year) not collapsing, on 1.34x volume (hold 120)
SQ7-BUYBACKVOL.rule: Share count down 3% or more over a year (dShares <= -0.03, known 30 days late); close no more than 34% under its 200-day average (d200 >= -0.34); today's volume >= 1.34x its 50-day average (turn50 >= 1.34). Rank: highest volume ratio first; max 10 a day. Hold 120 sessions.
SQ7-BUYBACKVOL.yardstick: capBoth (AUD-1 corrected: trades and yardstick capped at +300% alike)

SQ7-LAGEARN.why: block t 1.35 under 2.5 in the older half; lost money after 0.8% costs in the newer half; lost money after 1.2% costs in the newer half; not better than the average stock in the newer half; not better than the same stocks on their other days in the newer half; loses without its 2 best in the newer half; block t -2.71 under 2.5 in the newer half
SQ7-LAGEARN.name: Sector laggard under its 200-day with its next report near (hold 20)
SQ7-LAGEARN.rule: 59-85 calendar days since the last earnings report; 3-month return 10%+ under its sector median (rsSec <= -0.10, SIC 2-digit, 6+ liquid members); close under its 200-day average. Rank: furthest behind its sector first; max 10 a day. Hold 20 sessions.
SQ7-LAGEARN.yardstick: capBoth (AUD-1 corrected: trades and yardstick capped at +300% alike)
